description: Turns a plain-English instruction into a reviewable list of proposed flow changes, as the Automations editor's Describe box does: "make step 2 a text at 9am", "move every client reply to a 10 minute deadline". Give flowId to propose for ONE flow (the editor's own box); leave it out to read every active flow. It returns the changes (each with the flow, the step, a before/after and a patch), a one-sentence summary, and anything it deliberately left alone. It writes NOTHING: to make the changes, pick the rows your person agrees to and call apply_flow_ai_edit with the same command and summary. A question it could not read comes back as a clarification, never an empty diff. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same proposal.

asFlow.description: Turn down a recurring-task reading: build a flow instead, as the editor's "Make it a flow instead" does.

command.description: The instruction in the owner's words, e.g. "after the visit, text them to ask for a review".

flowId.description: Propose for this one flow (the editor's Describe box); omit to read every active flow.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: ai_edit_flow
title: Describe a flow change and get a proposal
